verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1991 (Mexico).

physical: Made by Sony Music Entertainment México, S.A. De C.V.

notes.text:
Reissued in vinyl for the first time since release 25 years ago. Part of the #LatinoamericaEnVinil series and of the record's 25 aniversary. Includes 4 page b/w inlay folder with photos, lyrics, credits and notes.

Recorded at Polygram México Studios, D.F., at Mad Dog Studio Venice Calif. and at Entourage Studio North Hollywood Calif.

Mixed at Can-Am Recorders Inc. Tarzana Calif.

Mastered at Future Disc Systems Inc. Hollywood Calif.

℗ 1991 BMG Bertelsmann de Mexico, S.A. de C.V.
